races.title: SIS Supporting Irish Racing Beginners Chase
races.verdict: KING RASKO GREY sets the standard on hurdles form and is taken to make a winning chase debut in a quality maiden, with the strength in depth at the yard making it no surprise that his chief dangers also come from Closutton, Kiely’s Place and Narciso Has both appealing as exciting recruits in their own right. KING RASKO GREY (FR) KIELY'S PLACE (IRE) NARCISO HAS (FR)

races.title: Activ8 Solar Energies Irish EBF Mares Handicap Chase
races.verdict: KARAMOJA caught the eye off this mark in the spring and, given time to get over her fall at Punchestown in May, is taken to double her tally in this sphere. Karia Des Blaises is likely to prove the main danger if avoiding mistakes, with The Great Nudie respected after shaping much better than the result on return. Break My Soul arrives on the back of a poor effort but is one to note if strong in the market. KARAMOJA (FR) KARIA DES BLAISES (FR) THE GREAT NUDIE (IRE)

races.title: EASYFIX Equine Handicap Chase (Listed)
races.verdict: WINGMEN showed good resolution to rally and lead close home at Navan a fortnight ago and is fancied to follow up back in handicap company. Western Diego is feared most returned to this venue having been placed in this race last year before landing a valuable C&D handicap, while Raffles Dolce Vita and Moudan are also respected. WINGMEN (IRE) WESTERN DIEGO (IRE) RAFFLES DOLCE VITA (FR)

races.title: Mullinam Hurdle (Grade 3)
races.verdict: SARATOGA ended last season firmly on the up with a Grade 1 success at Punchestown and gets a confident vote to make a winning return and successfully concede weight all round. Huntin Boots impressed when scoring at Gowran recently and appeals as the one to chase home Padraig Roche's hat-trick seeker ahead of Bartholomew . SARATOGA (IRE) HUNTIN BOOTS (IRE) BARTHOLOMEW
races.bettingForecast: Saratoga (5/4), Bartholomew (9/4), Huntin Boots (7/2), Ole Ole (11/2)

races.title: Close Brothers Rated Novice Hurdle
races.verdict: IF YOU BELIEVE confirmed previous promise when winning at Galway on return and, with the step up in trip likely to suit, he's fancied to follow up. Marco Du Seuil finally got off the mark at Cork 27 days ago and rates the main danger, while Joe Cool is another open to improvement on the back of 2 promising hurdle runs. IF YOU BELIEVE (IRE) MARCO DU SEUIL (FR) JOE COOL (IRE)

races.title: Kettles Country House Hotel Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: GREEN HINT looked a different proposition on his return when cruising clear for success in a Listowel bumper and appeals as one to keep on the right side as he starts off over hurdles. He gets the vote ahead of Premier Division who also showed useful form in bumpers, with Cristal Clere completing the shortlist. GREEN HINT (IRE) PREMIER DIVISION (IRE) CRISTAL CLERE (IRE)

races.title: Francis McGee Memorial Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: HEY NOW shaped well on his return when fourth at Wexford and with this longer trip a likely big plus, he edges the vote in this highly competitive handicap. Magic Day could emerge as the main danger on the back of a promising Navan sixth, although a clutch of others also need considering, including Fairlander , Dont Go Yet and Euro Agent . HEY NOW MAGIC DAY (IRE) FAIRLANDER (IRE)
